row.proto: void Ui_Update_EpisodeTimerNodes(void *ctx, void *node_holder, void *career, int32_t state, bool show_timer, uint32_t episode_index)
row.notes: Under the node at node_holder+8 creates/resolves a token node (0x145613fa1), strings episode_timer and extra_text (default lng_left) and bools show_timer (= show_timer arg), tile_show_icon and table_show_timer_text. If career is null it stops there. state 2 with a career save found (Career_Find_CareerSaveByPredicate on ctx[1]): token from gamedb challenge_career / state_colours_0 field one_shot, extra_text replaced, icon and timer text false, then for save slot episode_index it sets show_timer true if any sub item (stride 0x18, byte +0xc) is unset, else formats a localised text. Other states: token from g_Gdb_Database key 0x10d41be9a7a75da3; state 1 sets icon and timer text true; state 0 sets both false and writes lng_cc_open_date formatted from the time at (ctx[0]+0x68 episode table +0x5708, stride 0x80, +0x58) into episode_timer. Callers 0x14173b4b0 (challenge career item update) and FeTile_ChallengeCareerItem_Populate pass state 1; 0x1418a2690 (builds the full episode tile) passes the computed state.
